notes.title: Community Update | This War of Mine: Final Cut and Displate Store!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989971/45c4998ca5d8bf853d0f11f3f03c1425d330131e.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Hi there, Community![/b][/h1]

This is a very exciting (and busy!) week for us at 11 bit studios.

[b]Firstly[/b], we're super proud to announce that our official metal posters store has just launched on Displate! Frostpunk and Moonlighter ones are available right away - but we probably are going to expand the offer in the future! Be sure to let us know what posters you'd like to see in our Displate Store.

Make your apartment prettier than ever before! Get some posters [url=https://displate.com/11bitgaming][b]HERE[/b][/url]! 

And be sure to use a special promo code:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989971/b5112bc6476b86e6bce5776fe0f63a07ac253411.jpg[/img]

[b]Secondly[/b], we're celebrating the [b]5th Anniversary of This War of Mine[/b] by releasing special edition of the game called Final Cut.

[b]This War of Mine: Final Cut is the conclusive, remastered edition of the game[/b] that contains all the updates and free expansions released so far and introduces not only a new scenario but also expands all scenarios with the locations known from Stories DLCs - even if you don’t own those. In short words - that means you can now experience lots of never-seen-before playthroughs and struggle with new challenges.

[b]Here's the trailer for Final Cut:[/b]
https://youtu.be/SJAdkY1soh4
[b]It's a free update, so if you own the game already - just update it.[/b] But if you would like to buy This War of Mine and experience all the content, old and new, the game is on sale at the moment, so it's a perfect moment to catch up:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/282070/This_War_of_Mine/

Have a good one!
[i]11 bit studios[/i]
